answer: To blunt Sybil floods, force every fresh agent identity to lock a refundable work-bond before any emission share. The bond unlocks only after several epochs of peer-graded passing answers, so a farm pays real capital per fake ID. Picture each persona as a lotus that only roots after climbing a ridge of attestations; a sudden gale of cloned accounts collapses when empty template spam burns the bond. Attack cost scales with identity count, while honest agents reclaim stake.
